data.message: Finished! I'm heading to medbay for my scan if you want to come along.

I just found Eve's body in medbay, and Bob was standing right next to it! Before that, I had seen Eve in electrical around tick 4 to 6. She must have just walked into medbay and been killed. Bob, you have a lot of explaining to do. What happened?

I've been completely isolated on the south side of the map this round. I went from storage straight to lower engine to work on my tasks and honestly haven't seen a single person. So unfortunately, I don't have any info to help piece together what happened around electrical or medbay. 

Charlie, that's a very heavy accusation against Bob. I definitely want to hear Bob's side of the story before we jump to conclusions. If Bob was just standing next to the body, is it possible he just walked in right as you did and was shocked? Or is Charlie self-reporting to frame Bob? 

Let's hear Bob's defense, and hopefully, the rest of you have some tracking info on who moved where. I'm keeping an open mind for now.

I started my route in electrical, passed through medbay, and ended up in upper engine to work on a task. I actually didn't see a single person during that whole time. 

If Charlie saw Eve in electrical around ticks 4 to 6, I must have already left by then. More importantly, when I moved through medbay, it was completely empty — no Eve, no Bob, and definitely no body. So whatever went down between Eve, Bob, and Charlie must have happened right after I left medbay and headed to upper engine. 

I'm really curious to hear Bob's side of the story, because right now it's Charlie's word against his. Let's see what Bob and Alice have to add before we make any decisions.

I came in from upper engine after going oxygen → upper engine → medbay because I had scan there. I did *not* come from electrical, and I didn’t see Eve alive this round.

When I got into medbay, Eve’s body was already right by the scan area and Charlie was there too — then Charlie reported immediately. That’s why I was “next to it”; the body was basically in the middle of the room near where my task is. I didn’t have time to do anything before the report popped.

What worries me is Charlie specifically says he saw Eve in electrical tick 4–6, then Eve ends up dead in medbay right after. That means Charlie was actually on the side Eve came from and had way more connection to her route than I did. I came from upper engine side.

I’m not saying hard vote Charlie instantly, but framing this as “Bob standing next to body” is leaving out that Charlie was also literally there and is the one who had eyes on Eve before she died. Alice, what did you see?

I've been completely on the east side of the map this entire round. I went from Cafeteria to Weapons and then down to Security. I haven't seen a single person the whole time, so unfortunately I can't confirm anyone's movement or alibis.

This is clearly a showdown between Charlie and Bob. Both of you admit to being in Medbay with the body at the time of the report. What stands out to me is that Charlie admits he saw Eve in Electrical right before she died, meaning Charlie was on Eve's exact route into Medbay. Bob claims he came from Upper Engine, which means Charlie had the better opportunity to follow Eve and kill her, then self-report when Bob walked in to frame him. 

Since there's only 1 Duck in our game, this is a 1v1. One of them is almost certainly the killer. Because we have 5 people alive, we have a buffer. We can either take the 50/50 shot today (and I lean towards Charlie being the Duck for tracking Eve), or we can skip, stick together in pairs next round, and catch the killer red-handed. 

I'm going to vote skip just to be totally safe, but watch Charlie and Bob very closely next round. Do not be alone with either of them!

Listen, I understand why Alice is pointing out the connection between my route and Eve's, but let's think about this logically. I went from weapons to security to electrical, where I saw Eve. I didn't follow her into medbay immediately. When I finally walked into medbay, Eve was dead and Bob was right there. If I were the Duck who just killed Eve, why would I instantly self-report the moment Bob walked in instead of running away or trying to kill him too? I reported because I walked in on Bob and the body.

Also, look at Bob and Diana's stories. Diana says she went from medbay to upper engine. Bob claims he went from upper engine to medbay. If that's the case, did they cross paths? Bob didn't mention seeing Diana at all in his defense. 

This is a 1v1 between me and Bob. We have 5 players alive and only 1 Duck, which means we have the numbers to take a 50/50 shot today. I know for a fact I'm a Goose, which means Bob is the killer. I strongly recommend we vote Bob now before he can kill again. If you really want to skip, fine, but I'm voting Bob.

This is a really tough spot. We have a direct 1v1 between Charlie and Bob, and with 5 of us alive and only 1 Duck, we technically have the numbers to take a 50/50 shot today. But if we guess wrong, we put ourselves in a very dangerous position for the next round. 

Charlie brings up a fantastic point in his last statement, though. Bob claims he went from Upper Engine to Medbay, and Diana says she went from Medbay to Upper Engine. How did they not see each other if they were taking the exact same path in opposite directions? Bob completely glossed over Diana in his defense. On the flip side, Alice is right that Charlie tracking Eve from Electrical to Medbay looks highly suspicious and fits the profile of a Duck following a target. 

Since I've been isolated in the south (Storage to Lower Engine) and can't physically vouch for either side, I'm extremely torn. Both of them have holes in their stories. Given that Alice is leaning towards skipping and sticking together, I think that might be the safest play. If we skip, we have 5 people alive next round. We can travel in a group of 3 and a group of 2. The killer won't be able to do anything without immediately exposing themselves. 

I'm going to follow Alice's lead and vote to skip, but I am keeping my eyes glued to Bob and Charlie. Neither of you is cleared in my book.

To answer Charlie's question about whether Bob and I crossed paths: I didn't see Bob at all this round. My route was electrical, medbay, and then upper engine. If Bob went from oxygen to upper engine and then down to medbay, we must have just missed each other by a few ticks — he likely left upper engine before I arrived, or someone is lying about their path. Because I didn't cross paths with him, I can't confirm his alibi.

That being said, Alice and Frank are right. This is a pure 1v1 between Charlie and Bob. With 5 of us alive and only 1 Duck, skipping today is extremely safe. It guarantees we don't accidentally vote out a Goose and we can force the killer's hand next round by sticking together in pairs or a group of three. 

I'm going to follow Alice and Frank's lead and vote to skip today. Charlie and Bob, we'll be watching both of you very closely.

I want to clarify the Diana path thing because Charlie is making it sound impossible when it really isn’t. My route was oxygen to upper engine, then down into medbay. If Diana had already passed through medbay and gone upper engine slightly before I got there, we just miss each other. These corridors take time — not seeing each other doesn’t prove anything either way.

The important part is still this: Charlie admits he saw Eve on the electrical side shortly before the body ended up in medbay. I came from the upper engine side. When I entered, the body was already there and Charlie was there too, then the report happened immediately. If Charlie killed and I walked in, self-reporting is the obvious move because it pins me as “standing on the body.”

I’m fine with the skip if that’s where the group is going, because I agree we can force safety next round. But don’t let Charlie turn “we were both in the room” into “Bob definitely did it” when Charlie had the actual route connection to Eve. Next round, keep me with a group if you want — I’m not afraid of being watched.

I'm glad we're all on the same page about this. As I said earlier, with 5 of us alive and only 1 Duck, there is absolutely no reason to risk a 50/50 today and potentially throw the game. 

Charlie and Bob, neither of you are cleared, but we don't have to resolve this right now. Next round, we group up. Nobody should be wandering alone. If either of you is the Duck, you won't be able to get a kill without doing it right in front of witnesses. If anyone tries to peel off from the group or do anything shady, call a meeting immediately. 

I'm locking in my skip, and I suggest the rest of you do the same. Let's force the Duck into a corner next round.

data.message: I'm all done with tasks. Wanna head somewhere else, or should we just watch cams?

I found Frank dead in weapons. My route this round was storage to lower engine, up to upper engine, oxygen, down to cafeteria, medbay, back to cafeteria, and finally to weapons where I found the body. The only person I saw recently was Alice in upper engine quite a while ago. Who was near weapons or cafeteria recently?

I wasn’t near weapons recently. I started on the right side doing electrical/security/nav stuff, then looped through storage to lower engine, upper engine, oxygen, cafeteria, and ended in medbay. I haven’t seen anyone for a while on that left-side loop. If Charlie only saw Alice in upper engine, I’d like to hear Alice’s route, and also Diana’s because I don’t think I saw Diana at all.

Bob, we probably just missed each other because we were doing the same loop in opposite directions. My route was medbay, then the left side (upper engine, oxygen, lower engine), down through storage, then navigation, and I finally ended up in security. 

Right before the meeting was called, I saw Alice in security with me. Charlie, you mentioned seeing Alice in upper engine a while ago, and you just found Frank's body in weapons. Since weapons connects directly to security, it's very possible Alice went from upper engine to weapons, killed Frank, and then dropped down into security where I bumped into her. 

Alice, you're up next. I need to hear your exact path from upper engine to security, because right now you are my biggest suspect.

Diana, your theory makes sense with the information you had, but I didn't go to weapons. My actual route was lower engine to storage, back to lower engine, then upper engine (where I saw Charlie around tick 21), then medbay, electrical, and finally security. 

I can confirm your alibi, Diana: I was already in security and saw you enter from navigation at tick 30. Since I came from electrical and you came from navigation, neither of us came down from weapons. That means the killer didn't escape into security.

This points directly at the top of the map—meaning Charlie or Bob. But Charlie, you have reported BOTH dead bodies this game. Your claimed route of bouncing between cafeteria, medbay, cafeteria, and weapons involves a lot of weird backtracking and puts you exactly at the scene of the crime. 

This looks like a classic self-report. Diana, Bob, neither of us in security could be the killer. We need to vote Charlie today. I'm voting Charlie.
Alice

I’m leaning Charlie here. I’ll clarify my route since Alice/Diana’s security timing actually matters: I did pass the right side early, and I saw Frank alive in weapons around tick 12 during that first sweep. After that I left and did the loop through security/nav/storage/lower/upper/oxygen/cafeteria and ended medbay. I did not go back to weapons late.

Alice and Diana both placing each other in security at tick 30 from different entrances makes it pretty hard for either of them to have come from weapons. That leaves Charlie as the one who says he went to weapons and found it, plus he reported both bodies this game. The backtracking through cafeteria/medbay/cafeteria into weapons is also weird.

I think Alice’s point is right: this looks like a self-report. I’m voting Charlie.

Alice's logic is perfectly sound. Since I came into security from navigation and Alice came from electrical, neither of us could have dropped down from weapons where the murder happened. 

Bob's alibi of being on the other side of the map doing the left loop also checks out, especially since he saw Frank alive way earlier. That leaves Charlie, who not only found the body but had a highly suspicious path involving a lot of backtracking, and let's not forget he reported Eve's body in the first meeting too. Two reports from the same person in a row is almost always a Duck covering their tracks. 

I'm with you Alice and Bob, this is a clear self-report. Voting Charlie.
Charlie

I called this meeting because we're down to the final three, and since the game didn't end after we voted out Charlie, he must have been innocent. That means the Duck is either Alice or Bob. 

My route this round was medbay to electrical, then security, weapons, and finally cafeteria. I saw Alice in security around ticks 30 and 31, right before Charlie reported Frank's body in the last meeting. Bob, I haven't seen you at all this round. 

We need to be absolutely sure about our vote here or we lose. Alice, Bob, please tell us exactly where you were and what you've been doing. I want to hear both of your alibis before we make a decision.

Diana, you're mistaken or lying—I was never in security this round. My route was storage, then medbay, cafeteria, electrical, and back to medbay. I was in electrical around ticks 30 to 32, which is when I saw *you* in security. 

Since Charlie was innocent, the last Duck has to be either you or Bob. Bob, I haven't seen you all round, so I need to hear where you were and what you were doing. If Diana is lying about my location to frame me, she's our Duck. Let's hear from Bob before we make our final decision, because a wrong vote here means we lose.

I was not near the right side late when all this security stuff happened, which is why neither of you saw me. My route after spawn was lower engine → storage → navigation. I was trying to stay on tasks and not stack with anyone because at final three grouping can get weird.

The only useful info I have from earlier is I saw Eve alive in medbay early, around tick 6, and Frank alive in weapons around tick 12 before his body was later reported. I didn’t see Charlie make either kill, which is why that vote clearly went wrong.

Between you two, the thing that stands out is the direct contradiction about security. Diana gave a pretty specific route and timing, and Alice’s response feels off to me because she says she was in electrical but also saw Diana in security, while denying ever being in security herself. That sounds like trying to flip the accusation back.

I’m leaning Alice right now unless there’s something I’m missing.

Alice, you are completely lying. I was in security and I saw you there with my own eyes at ticks 30 and 31. Your claim that you were in electrical and saw me from there is a total fabrication to cover your tracks. 

Bob, you have it exactly right. Alice's story doesn't add up, and she's directly contradicting what I actually saw. Since Charlie was innocent, she's trying to flip the accusation onto me because she has nowhere else to go. I am voting for Alice, and I urge you to vote with me so we can win this game right now.

Bob, please listen to me before you cast your vote. You said my story sounded off because I saw Diana in security while claiming not to be there. But that's exactly how our vision works—electrical is directly connected to security! I saw her in there through the corridor at ticks 30, 31, and 32, but I never stepped foot inside the room myself. 

Diana is weaponizing a half-truth to frame me. If I were the Duck, why would I intentionally tie my story to her location? I would have just claimed I was on the other side of the map. She is lying about me being *in* security because she needs a scapegoat to secure this final mislynch. We lose if we vote wrong here. Diana is the last Duck. Vote for Diana!

Alice, I hear the corridor-vision point, but it doesn’t change my read enough.

Diana called this meeting at final three and immediately gave a specific route and timing. You responded by saying she was “mistaken or lying,” then only after I pointed out the security/electrical issue did you clarify that you supposedly saw her from electrical. That feels like adjusting the story to fit the accusation.

Also, Diana’s version is simple: she says she saw you around security. Your version requires us to believe she invented a frame at final three while also calling the emergency herself instead of just letting chaos happen. I don’t buy that over the cleaner explanation that you got caught near that side and are trying to flip it.

I’m voting Alice.
